newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes up as banks sell dollars.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes up as banks sell dollars.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed stronger in thin trade on Monday as banks sold dollars, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.65 after opening at 57.70. The rupee closed at 57.73 on Friday.
"There were more sellers than buyers of dollars because banks are not sure of the future direction of the exchange rate," said a foreign bank dealer.
The dollar-rupee exchange rate, which has stagnated in the past week, has sent speculators to the sidelines, he said.
Overnight call money rates closed at 10 percent after opening at 11.5 percent, dealers said.
